theme.description: Premium, modern, romantic, and Gen-Z friendly matchmaking experience. Designed with deep wine burgundy (#4A1224 & #2B0A15), warm dusty rose (#A3485E), soft blush pink (#FCEEF2), and warm ivory (#FAF6F0). No cartoon hearts, no AI slop, no excessive neon gradients — grounded in editorial intimacy, clean typography, tactile pill chips, and mobile-first micro-interactions with INR currency symbols (₹) and Indian UPI flows.

entry_surfaces./: editorial hero with warm ivory backdrop, romantic typography & primary CTA left, paired with curated photo pill collage right
entry_surfaces./register: 4-step romantic registration workflow with breadcrumb progress indicator, interactive pill selections, and photo upload
entry_surfaces./payment: clean UPI payment portal with dynamic QR card, copyable UPI ID, UTR input and screenshot upload proof
entry_surfaces./status/:id: private status lookup card with round progression timeline and verified match disclosure drawer
entry_surfaces./admin/login: focused split admin authentication screen with wine burgundy backdrop and secure credentials form
entry_surfaces./admin: desktop-first dual-pane admin command center with round metrics, applicant table, and 3-column matchmaking engine

layouts_and_grids.mobile_first_strategy: All public pages (Landing, Registration, Payment, Status, FAQ, Terms) must be hyper-responsive and optimized for 360px-430px mobile screens with sticky bottom CTA bar on mobile registration and large touch targets (min 44px height).
landing_page_structure: Top sticky glass header with SoulMatch logo, How It Works, Rounds, FAQ, Instagram icon & 'Join Round' button

Hero section with headline 'Your Next Love Story Starts Here.', subtitle 'Meet someone who matches your vibe, values and personality.', live Round status pill with countdown/entries left, and primary CTA 'Join the Matchmaking Round'
Visual Social Proof / Editorial Highlights banner with subtle couple portraits and authentic testimonial quotes
How It Works: 5 intuitive numbered steps (1. Register & Photo, 2. Personality & Partner Vibe, 3. UPI Payment ₹, 4. Curated Matchmaking by Team, 5. Matches Unveiled via Email & Private Link)
Curated Personality Dimensions Showcase (Dating Vibe, Sunday Energy, Conflict Style, Shared Values)
Previous Round Highlights (Success stories & statistics if data exists, or 'Round 1 Launching Now' badge)
Transparent FAQ accordion (Privacy, curated human matching, payment verification, match delivery)
Footer with SoulMatch brand mark, Tagline 'Find Your Person.', Instagram handle link, Privacy Policy, Terms & Conditions, and Admin link

admin_matchmaking_3_column.desktop_layout: Grid with 3 synchronized panels: Left (Applicants List with filters & round selector), Center (Active Selected Candidate profile & preferences deep-dive), Right (Candidate Match Pool with auto-calculated compatibility % breakdown, multi-select match assignment, email preview & manual copy trigger).
admin_matchmaking_3_column.mobile_adaptation: Tabbed view on small screens switching between 'Applicants', 'Profile', and 'Match Pool'.

principles: Subtle micro-interactions on button hover and chip clicks (spring 0.15s ease).
Step transition in multi-step registration with horizontal slide fade.
Compatibility match score gauge with smooth circular progress counter (0 to 100%).
Copy-to-clipboard toast notifications with Sonner rich colors.
Avoid heavy 3D canvases to keep initial mobile load lightning fast and instant on mobile browsers.

accessibility.wcag_compliance: All normal text tokens maintain >= 4.5:1 contrast against light and dark surfaces. Form inputs include explicit labels and focus rings with wine burgundy glow. Chips toggle aria-pressed or aria-checked.
accessibility.data_testids: All buttons, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, and status badges MUST carry distinct data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='register-step-1-submit', data-testid='upi-utr-input', data-testid='admin-match-assign-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the wine burgundy (#4A1224) and warm ivory (#FAF6F0) brand palette consistently across frontend and backend.
Registration must be a pleasant 4-step wizard with local state persistence so applicants don't lose data on back navigation.
Support INR (₹) pricing format for registration rounds (e.g. ₹199 / ₹299).
UPI Payment screen must support manual UTR entering, screenshot upload (base64 or local upload API), and copy UPI ID button with instant toast.
Applicant Status page must be accessible via unguessable ID link (e.g. /status/:id or /status?app_id=SM-...) without requiring a password/login.

Admin Matchmaking Dashboard is the crown jewel: render the 3-panel workflow with compatibility score breakdown (Vibe match, Values match, Intention alignment), multi-select assignment, and one-click 'Copy HTML / Plain Text Email' with 'Mark as Sent' logger.
Include pre-seeded sample applicants, rounds, and admin credentials (admin@soulmatch.in / admin123) in backend seed.py so the app is instantly testable and vibrant.
Add Instagram link support, Privacy Policy, Terms, and customizable UPI QR / UPI ID in Admin Settings.
